run_generate_vendor_table: run generate_vendor_table to produce C-style initializer lines from a SPIR-V XML registry
run_main_cli: run main CLI to generate a vendor tool table from a SPIR-V XML registry file
parse_xml_registry: parse a SPIR-V XML registry file and extract vendor and tool ID entries
generate_c_initializers: generate C-style struct initializer lines for vendor tool registry entries
write_output_file: write generated vendor table output to a specified file path
